clinical_focus_areas.title: Antenatal Care & High-Risk Pregnancy
clinical_focus_areas.description: Comprehensive journey tracking, trimester guidance, personalized prenatal plans, fetal health monitoring, and supportive maternal counseling.

clinical_focus_areas.title: Postnatal Recovery & Lactation Support
clinical_focus_areas.description: Holistic postpartum wellness, pelvic floor recovery, newborn transition guidance, emotional health assessment, and breast care support.

clinical_focus_areas.title: Adolescent Health & Puberty Counseling
clinical_focus_areas.description: Sensitive, confidential guidance for young women navigating hormonal shifts, menstrual health, PCOS, and body awareness.

clinical_focus_areas.title: Perimenopause & Menopause Management
clinical_focus_areas.description: Tailored HRT guidance, bone health strategies, mood elevation, lifestyle therapy, and symptom relief throughout the menopausal transition.

clinical_focus_areas.title: Second Medical Opinion & Diagnostic Review
clinical_focus_areas.description: Thorough, compassionate review of ultrasound scans, lab reports, surgical proposals, and complex gynecology diagnoses with 22+ years of insight.

aesthetic_archetype.name: Warm Editorial Healthcare
aesthetic_archetype.vibe: Warm, tactile, empathetic, dignified, authoritative without cold clinical friction
design_principles: Tactile Warmth over Clinical Coldness: Ivory backgrounds, deep teal structure, muted coral accents
Generous Whitespace: 2x-3x standard padding to let emotionally sensitive content breathe
Editorial Hierarchy: Serif headings paired with ultra-legible humanist sans-serif body text
Calm Motion: Soft 0.3s cubic-bezier reveals and smooth tab transitions, strictly respecting reduced motion
Trust & Transparency: Explicit 22-year credentialing badges, direct contact links, and clear availability cadences

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif tracking-tight leading-snug

layouts_and_grids.hero_section: Asymmetric editorial split: Left column (60%) with typography, trust pill, quote, and instant CTA; Right column (40%) with overlapping framed doctor portrait, experience badge, and quick schedule widget.
layouts_and_grids.profile_section: Dual-column narrative: Dr. Nisha Ghelani story, 22-year timeline stats grid (22+ Years Experience, 15,000+ Patient Consults, 100% Confidential Care), philosophy callout in soft tinted canvas.
layouts_and_grids.clinical_care_pathways: Tabbed interactive grid with tab switches for Antenatal, Postnatal, Puberty, Menopause, and Diagnostic Review. Each tab displays clinical rationale, key symptoms addressed, and direct 'Book pathway' action.
layouts_and_grids.booking_engine: Multi-step interactive schedule wizard on-site with date picker (restricting to Tue/Thu/Sat), time slot picker, consultation type toggle (Clinic Visit / Video Consultation / Diagnostic Second Opinion), patient detail form, and immediate saved request state with confirmation modal + contact fallback details.
layouts_and_grids.weekly_cadence: Visual weekly calendar grid highlighting Tue, Thu, Sat active appointment windows, closed days clearly specified with polite advance scheduling notes.
layouts_and_grids.patient_faq: Accordion system addressing privacy, report review procedure, appointment preparation, and payment/cancellation guidance.
layouts_and_grids.statutory_notice: High contrast emergency caveat footer banner clarifying that elective consultation is not for acute obstetric emergencies.

mobile_ergonomics.sticky_quick_action_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (< 768px) with 'Call Doctor' quick-action button (+91 6355734167) and 'Book Consultation' bottom sheet trigger.
mobile_ergonomics.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height on all buttons, select inputs, and interactive badges.
mobile_ergonomics.bottom_sheet: Responsive schedule drawer on mobile devices with smooth drag/slide behavior.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select triggers, tab triggers, accordion buttons, modal controls, quick action bar) MUST include clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-book-now-button', data-testid='booking-submit-btn', data-testid='tab-antenatal').
testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant text contrast ratios against #FAF8F5 and #FFFFFF surfaces.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full focus states (ring-2 ring-[#114B5F]) on all interactive inputs and buttons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure header uses backdrop blur with non-transparent background (#FAF8F5/90 with backdrop-blur-md) so text stays legible when scrolling.
Persist appointment bookings into local storage or backend API with immediate confirmation modal showing booking reference, doctor contact details, and next steps.
Implement date validation on schedule engine: disable Mon, Wed, Fri, Sun selections and enable Tue, Thu, Sat.
Include responsive mobile quick-action bar with direct telephone link (tel:+916355734167) and booking trigger.
Never use raw transparent header backgrounds or generic centered AI templates.
